Over time, Mega Millions underwent significant changes, switching from five numbers plus a Mega Ball to six numbers plus a Mega Ball, and modified its initial jackpots from a set $8 million to a growing jackpot currently worth around $22 million.
The new formula adopted by Mega Millions to become more competitive with Powerball means that second-prize winning tickets will be available more frequently — in every other draw instead of every fourth draw.
